config.selection: All arm/head/seed selections use validation only and finish before loading any test arrays.
config.standardization: Each head uses only its valid training rows for mean/std; no shared learned trunk.
config.target_contract: Input previous/current; forecast next_1 and next_2 from SAME features. No teacher-forced future word in head2.
config.loss_contract: Horizon CE separate; mean across valid overlapping forecasts is NOT sequence perplexity.
config.masked_outputs: Unscored horizon losses are NaN and predictions -1 in NPZ; all metrics use target_mask.
limitations: Brain dynamics and all synapses remain frozen; only readout weights/biases train.
Independent head2 training cannot improve head1 representations because no learned trunk is shared.
Direct arm measures decodability of engineered ordered sensory input without the brain.
Overlapping forecasts are correlated; use story-level paired analysis, not independent-token significance.

next_1.interpretation: Next-word conditional metrics, comparable to original next-word readout.

next_2.interpretation: Second-future-word forecast from the same current state; exp(CE) is not next-word sequence perplexity.

forecast_average.interpretation: Token-weighted mean over valid overlapping horizon forecasts, NOT standard sequence perplexity.
